boundaries: Explanatory-design review is not an empirical reader-comprehension experiment.
Browser evidence uses installed macOS Chrome and emulated viewport widths, not every physical device or browser.
The Python option covers the 44 Java-labelled fences, including some C++ or mixed originals, not code embedded in faithful original-figure reproductions.
English pages remain the repository's public excerpts; the supplied complete EPUB was used locally for comparison.
Original-vector fonts, stroke textures and tiny flag contours are approximations, not pixel-identical raster reconstructions.
Remote links and authentication flows were not audited.
Chapter opening maps and closing storylines are generated from per-chapter content data; their review is explanatory-design judgment recorded in chapter-figures-review.json.
Commits and deployment for the 2026-09-21 chapter-figure work were performed by the maintainer's session; earlier acceptance rounds were not committed by their reviewers.
